svg.title: Agentic AI Platform — target architecture and delivery status (V3)
svg.desc: Target architecture for an agentic AI platform. A central governed lifecycle runs top to bottom through eight vector-connected stages: user and goal entry, intake and planning, agent orchestration, governance and authorization with an explicit human approval control gate, MCP and tool interoperability, controlled execution, evaluation, and audit and outcome. Governance and the human approval gate precede the MCP tool gateway and controlled execution, and no agent invokes a tool directly. Supporting platform services sit to the right and connect into the lifecycle where relevant: model and memory services support orchestration, state and checkpointing supports the workflow lifecycle, observability spans platform execution, and deployment and operations supports the platform without sitting inside the execution path. MCP interoperability is marked in progress. PostgreSQL durable workflow state, Docker, Docker Compose, and OpenTelemetry observability are marked planned and are not claimed as implemented. GitHub Actions CI is marked implemented in the public repository.
